root_causes_identified: Block response format: miner field uses 0x prefix instead of xdc, missing XDC-specific fields (penalties, validator, validators, totalDifficulty)
Gas price: default 1 Gwei instead of 18 Gwei (XDC mainnet value)
Network ID: returns 89 instead of 51 (UAE testnet vs XDC Apothem)
Syncing: returns sync progress object instead of false when idle
Error code mismatches: several methods return different JSON-RPC error codes than the xdpos baseline
XDPoS methods: newer build has different method signatures and error handling
Version string: audit build version differs from xdpos baseline
Finality value: returns 33 instead of 0 for genesis block finality
Signers for genesis: returns zero-address array instead of empty array
